name: Terrible Specimen! A Slanderous Girl, Taken Away by the Demon!!!! (¡Terribilisimo ejemplar! Una niña calumniadora, á quien se lleva el demonio!!!!), after 1891
note: Relief engraving (print), 9 × 13.3 cm, published and printed by Antonio Vanegas Arroyo. The MoMA record dates it after 1891 and marks it a work in progress.
credit: Larry Aldrich Fund; The Museum of Modern Art, New York, object number 419.1954
